paragraphs: Evidence-based mental health services in Van Nuys, CA, for anxiety, depression, trauma, and more – delivered by licensed professionals through our trusted outpatient programs.
Located in the heart of Van Nuys, our outpatient treatment center is designed to feel familiar, fostering comfort, healing, and a sense of community.

Our holistic approach integrates therapeutic programs and experiential treatments to support your whole self. Your dedicated team works one-on-one with you to uncover and address the root causes of your challenges.
The compassionate clinical team at Clear Behavioral Health works with you to determine the specialized outpatient or residential services that will work best for you today and every step of the way.

Our adult outpatient program supports individuals managing anxiety, depression, trauma, and other mental health challenges. With flexible scheduling and a coordinated approach that combines therapy and psychiatry, we help you build lasting skills for healing and long-term wellness.

Our teen mental health Program is designed for adolescents facing emotional or behavioral challenges. With age-appropriate care, individual and family therapy, and support for managing school-life balance, we help teens develop emotional regulation, build resilience, and gain the tools they need to navigate life with confidence and stability.

At Clear Behavioral Health, we’re not just experts in treating your mental health. We’re adept at helping you navigate your insurance to facilitate treatment, accepting most major insurance and plans. Call today and let us help you through the maze.
Let us help you through the maze.
Our thoughtfully designed, in-network mental health and/or addiction programs are delivered affordably in a comfortable setting nearby, or online across California.

Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our medically supervised detox program provides 24/7 care in a safe, supportive environment for people withdrawing from drugs or alcohol. With continuous monitoring and evidence-based safety protocols, we help manage withdrawal symptoms and prepare clients for the next step in recovery.

Our residential rehab program offers full-time, structured care for individuals recovering from substance use, either following detox or as a primary treatment. With an average stay of 30+ days, clients receive daily therapy, medical support, relapse prevention planning, and holistic services in a supportive environment.

Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

Our Outpatient Rehab offers flexible addiction treatment for individuals who don’t require 24/7 residential care. With options such as Intensive Outpatient (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization (PHP), this level of support is ideal for those transitioning from inpatient care or managing recovery alongside daily responsibilities.

The teen years are complicated for everyone and impact an entire family. If you are concerned that your teen is experiencing significant mental health or addiction issues, Clear Behavioral Health’s team of compassionate adolescent mental health experts can help.

We specialize in a range of affordable and flexible teen-focused services to meet the needs of each unique adolescent, addressing mental health challenges and unhealthy coping mechanisms by treating underlying causes and contributing factors, such as attitudes, values and family dynamics. Together, we’ll work with you to determine which services will work best for your teen.
Clear Behavioral Health has supported the wellbeing of clients throughout Southern California for over a decade.

Welcome to Clear Behavioral Health’s Van Nuys treatment center, where your mental health and well-being are our top priorities. Our inviting facility is thoughtfully designed to provide a safe, structured, and healing environment for individuals and families. With private therapy rooms, comfortable group spaces, and dedicated school support areas for teens, our setting is tailored to meet diverse needs.

Our center also features wellness amenities to promote holistic healing and offers inclusive services such as all-gender restrooms and culturally sensitive programming to ensure everyone feels respected and valued. At Clear Behavioral Health Van Nuys, you’ll find compassionate care in a nurturing space designed to help you on your journey toward lasting wellness.
Look for the Clear Behavioral Health wave logo on the white gate. Enter through the gate, park in the lot, and join us through the front door.

Care is only as effective as the experts providing it, and we’re not shy about telling the world that some of the best in the business are right here at Clear Behavioral Health. But don’t just take our word for it – get to know them yourselves.

@graph.name: Depression
@graph.description: Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.

@graph.name: Anxiety Disorders
@graph.description: While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.

@graph.name: Chronic Stress and Burnout
@graph.description: When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.

@graph.name: ADHD
@graph.description: Often considered disorganized or flighty, those with ADHD and learning disorders need professional support to maintain concentration.

@graph.name: Bipolar Disorder
@graph.description: Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.

@graph.name: OCD
@graph.description: Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.

@graph.name: PTSD
@graph.description: Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.

@graph.name: Addiction and Substance Abuse
@graph.description: For some, dependence on the use of drugs or alcohol or even specific activities or behaviors can interfere with everyday life.

mainEntity.name: How much does outpatient mental health treatment cost in Van Nuys?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of outpatient mental health treatment varies based on the condition we’re treating and the support we’re providing. What you can expect to pay out-of-pocket depends on your insurance provider and plan. Get in touch and we can help you navigate your insurance plans to find appropriate treatment options.

mainEntity.name: Can teens receive outpatient mental health treatment in Van Nuys?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer teen mental health treatment at our Van Nuys location in an outpatient format. Learn more about our teen programs.

mainEntity.name: What mental health conditions are treated in outpatient programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outpatient mental health programs at Clear Behavioral Health in Van Nuys treat a wide range of conditions, including: Depression Anxiety Disorders Chronic Stress and Burnout ADHD and Learning Disorders Bipolar Disorder Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) and Trauma Addiction and Substance Abuse

mainEntity.name: How long does treatment typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment cost varies depending on insurance coverage and specific program details and duration. Contact Us to discuss your needs and we’ll help you understand what is covered or not and what out-of-pocket costs may exist for your specific program.
